scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Ah, I sense you have endured
a past life experience. You must have learned many things before entering Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
啊，我感觉到你经历过前世。
在进入瓦尔哈拉之前，你一定学到了很多东西。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Unfortunately, I don't think you're ready to become an Acolyte yet. Please finish learning all of the Basic Skills first.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
很遗憾，我觉得你还没准备好成为服事。
请先学会所有的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
In the meantime,
I will wait until
you are ready.
May God be
with you.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
在此期间，
我会等你准备好。
愿上帝与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I welcome you
back from Valhalla and
wish you luck on your
new life's journey.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
欢迎从瓦尔哈拉归来，
祝你在新的人生旅途中好运。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Now, venture forth and seek those who need your help. May God light your path.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
现在，出发去寻找那些需要帮助的人吧。愿上帝照亮你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Now, venture forth to seek people who need your help. May God enlighten your way.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
现在，出发去寻找那些需要帮助的人吧。愿上帝指引你的方向。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I sense that you have endured a past life experience. You must have learned many things before entering Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
我感觉到你经历过前世。
在进入瓦尔哈拉之前，你一定学到了很多东西。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
However, I can tell that you are not suited to be an Acolyte. Please remember who you were in your past life and find your path.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
然而，我能看出你不适合成为服事。
请铭记你前世的身份，找到属于你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
What is it that you seek?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你想要什么？

scripts.text: Father, I want to be a Acolyte.
scripts.translation: 神父，我想成为服事。

scripts.text: Acolyte Requirements.
scripts.translation: 服事的要求。

scripts.text: Just looking around.
scripts.translation: 只是随便看看。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Are you feeling okay today? I can tell by your attire that you are already an Acolyte. You're not joking around, are you?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你今天感觉还好吗？从你的装束来看，你已经是服事了。你是在开玩笑吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I'm sorry, but we can only accept Novices as applicants for the job change to Acolyte.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
很抱歉，我们只接受初心者申请转职为服事。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Do you truly
wish to become
a servant of God?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你真的
想成为
上帝的仆人吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Oh, you've come back. Let me check and see if you are ready to serve God. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
哦，你回来了。让我看看你是否准备好侍奉上帝了。让我看看...

scripts.text: Yes Father, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，神父，我愿意。

scripts.text: Nope, I lied.
scripts.translation: 不，我骗你的。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Good. I accept {0}'s will to become an Acolyte. You understand that you must do penance before you can become a servant of God, right?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
很好。我接受{0}成为服事的意愿。你知道在成为上帝的仆人之前必须忏悔，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I will
give you a mission...
Please visit ^000077Father Rubalkabara^000000, a member of the Prontera Parish, and return here. He has been practicing asceticism in the ^000077Relics NorthEast of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
好吧，我会给你一个任务...
请去拜访普隆德拉教区的成员^000077鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父^000000，然后回来。他正在^000077普隆德拉城东北方的遗迹^000000中修行苦行。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I will
give you a mission...
Please visit ^000077Mother Mathilda^000000 and then return to me. She has been practicing asceticism near ^000077Morocc Town, SouthWest of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
好吧，我会给你一个任务...
请去拜访^000077玛蒂尔达修女^000000，然后回来找我。她正在^000077普隆德拉城西南方的莫洛奇镇附近^000000修行苦行。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I will
give you a mission...
Please visit ^000077Father Yosuke^000000 and return here. He has been practicing asceticism around ^000077a bridge somewhere NorthWest of Prontera^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
好吧，我会给你一个任务...
请去拜访^000077阳介神父^000000，然后回来。他正在^000077普隆德拉西北方某处的一座桥上^000000修行苦行。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
May the grace of God light your path and guide you during your journey of penance.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
愿上帝的恩典照亮你的道路，指引你完成忏悔之旅。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
You lied?
It is good that you
have confessed your
wrongdoing. Go in
peace, my son.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你撒谎了？
你能坦白自己的过错，这很好。
愿上帝保佑你，我的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Good Lord! Haven't you accomplished the Basic Training yet?! It's important that you finish that!
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
天哪！你还没有完成基础训练吗？！完成它非常重要！

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Oh? I can't find your name on the Registration List.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
哦？我在注册名单上找不到你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Hmm...
Your name is on the list and you've proven your qualification.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
嗯...
你的名字在名单上，而且你已经证明了你的资格。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
You should have trained more! Go back and make sure you reach Novice Job Level 9 and learn all of the Basic Skills!
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你应该多训练一下！回去确保你的职业等级达到初心者9级，并学会所有基本技能！

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Please visit ^000077Father Rubalkabara^000000, a member of the Prontera Parish, and return here.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
请去拜访普隆德拉教区的成员^000077鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父^000000，然后回来。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
He has been practicing asceticism in the ^000077Relics at the NorthEast of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
他正在^000077普隆德拉城东北方的遗迹^000000中修行苦行。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Please Visit ^000077Mother Mathilda^000000 and return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
请去拜访^000077玛蒂尔达修女^000000，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
She has been practicing asceticism near ^000077Morocc Town, located SouthWest of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
她正在^000077位于普隆德拉城西南方的莫洛奇镇附近^000000修行苦行。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Please visit ^000077 Father Yosuke ^000000 and return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
请去拜访^000077 阳介神父 ^000000，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
He has been practicing asceticism near a ^000077bridge somewhere to the NorthWest of Prontera^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
他正在^000077普隆德拉西北方某处的一座桥附近^000000修行苦行。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
May the grace of God brighten your path and guide you on your journey of penance.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
愿上帝的恩典照亮你的道路，指引你完成忏悔之旅。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I am proud to say that you are now ready to become an Acolyte!
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
我很自豪地告诉你，你现在已经准备好成为服事了！

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Always remember to be thankful to God, who is taking care of us all the time.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
永远记得感谢上帝，祂一直在照顾着我们。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Always use your gifts to serve Him by helping others. In chaos and times of difficulty, face your hardships with unwavering faith.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
永远利用你的天赋去侍奉祂，帮助他人。在混乱和困难时期，以坚定的信念面对你的苦难。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Lastly, I want to sincerely congratulate you on persevering through your trial of penance.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
最后，我想真诚地祝贺你坚持完成了忏悔的考验。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Do you wish to become an Acolyte? You must fulfill two requirements.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你愿意成为服事吗？你必须满足两个条件。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
First, you have to reach at least Novice Job Level 9 and learn all of the Basic Skills. Second, you will be given a trial of penance to overcome.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
首先，你必须达到初心者职业等级9，并学会所有基本技能。其次，你需要接受一项忏悔的考验。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
For your trial, please visit ^000077Father Rubalkabara ^000000 and then return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
为了你的考验，请去拜访^000077鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父^000000，然后回到我这里。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
For your trial, please visit ^000077Mother Mathilda^000000 and return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
为了你的考验，请去拜访^000077玛蒂尔达修女^000000，然后回到我这里。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
For your trial, please visit ^000077Father Yosuke^000000 and return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
为了你的考验，请去拜访^000077阳介神父^000000，然后回到我这里。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
The destination for this trial will be decided once you fill the application form.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
这项考验的目的地将在你填写申请表后决定。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
He is practicing asceticism in the ^000077Relics at the NorthEast of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
他正在普隆德拉城东北方的^000077遗迹^000000中修行苦行。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
She has been practicing asceticism near ^000077Morocc, located to the SouthWest of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
她一直在普隆德拉城西南方的^000077莫洛克^000000附近修行苦行。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
He has been practicing asceticism around a bridge somewhere ^000077NorthWest of Prontera^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
他一直在普隆德拉^000077西北方^000000某座桥附近修行苦行。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
May the grace of God light your path and guide you on your journey of penance.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
愿上帝的恩典照亮你的道路，指引你完成忏悔之旅。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Please come back after fulfilling the two requirements I've asked of you. As long as your desire to serve God and others is sincere, you will be able to make it.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
请在满足我要求的两个条件后回来。只要你对侍奉上帝和他人的渴望是真诚的，你就能做到的。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Please take care. They should know that you've met me by the time you arrive at the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
请小心。等你到达普隆德拉圣堂时，他们应该已经知道你来过这里了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh...? You must be the one who aspires to become an Acolyte. I've already received news from the Sanctuary that you might be coming.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
哦...？你就是那位渴望成为服事的人吧。我已经从圣堂那里收到消息，说你可能要来了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh...
Are you one of the
Acolyte applicants...?
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
哦...
你是服事的申请者之一吗...？
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Huh? What brings you here? This is a very dangerous place for a Novice like yourself!
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
咦？什么事把你带到这儿了？对于像你这样的初心者来说，这里非常危险！

scripts.text: [Father Rubalkabara]
scripts.translation: [鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Greetings.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh ho...
Have you come into the Deep here for training? Or are you just a Wanderer?
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
哦呵...
你是来这里训练的吗？还是只是一个浪姬舞者？

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I've sent a carrier pigeon with a message. I hope it will arrive there safely...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
我派了一只信鸽带着消息去了。希望它能平安到达那里...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Now, your name was {0}, right? Excellent, thank you for visiting me.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
那么，你的名字是{0}，对吧？很好，谢谢你来看我。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I believe you've been told much about Acolytes from Friar Mareusis. Plus, there's plenty of helpful people in the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
我想马鲁西斯神父已经向你介绍过很多关于服事的事情了。而且，普隆德拉圣堂里也有很多乐于助人的人。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I guess there's really no need for me to teach you much. Besides, I'm sure your someone from your generation may have trouble listening to an old man like me. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
我想确实没什么需要我教你的了。况且，我相信你们年轻人可能不太愿意听我这种老头子说话。哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Still, lessons may come from the places you'd least expect. God loves to teach his children in strange ways. You'll see.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
不过，教训往往来自你意想不到的地方。上帝喜欢用奇怪的方式教导他的孩子。你会明白的。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Well, I'll send the message telling them that you've come to visit me. So, you may now return to the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
好了，我会派人通知他们你来看过我了。现在，你可以回到普隆德拉圣堂了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
再见。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Your name is {0}?
I don't think your name
is on my list. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
你的名字是{0}？
我的名单上好像没有你的名字。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Why don't you go back to the Prontera Sanctuary and check again?
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
你不如回到普隆德拉圣堂再确认一下吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Welcome to the Deep. Feel free to sit and contemplate God's message with me. This place is beautiful, even if danger accompanies its sense of serenity...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
欢迎来到深渊。请随意坐下，和我一起冥想上帝的旨意。这里很美，尽管伴随着宁静的是危险...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Whoever you are, please take care of yourself. The monsters in here are shockingly strong, contrary to their cute appearance.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
无论你是谁，请照顾好自己。这里的魔物虽然外表可爱，但实力惊人。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will send a carrier pigeon to the Prontera Sanctuary. When you return, the Priest there should already have received my message.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
我会派信鸽去普隆德拉圣堂。等你回来时，那里的牧师应该已经收到我的消息了。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Ah, you must be one of the Acolyte applicants. I sincerely welcome you.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
啊，你一定是服事的申请者之一。我真诚地欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Ah...!
You must be one
of the Acolyte applicants.
I sincerely welcome you.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
啊...！
你一定是服事的申请者之一。
我真诚地欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
...

scripts.text: [Mother Mathilda]
scripts.translation: [玛蒂尔达修女]

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Hello there~
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
你好~

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
May God
be with you...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
愿上帝与你同在...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will pray to God, and hope that you become an Acolyte soon.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
我会向上帝祈祷，希望你能早日成为服事。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
What is your name? {0}? Let's see... Ah, you're on my list.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
你叫什么名字？{0}？让我看看...啊，你在我的名单上。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will send a message to the Sanctuary confirming that you, {0} visited me and completed your penance.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
我会发消息给圣堂，确认你，{0}，已经拜访过我并完成了忏悔。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Please return to the Prontera Sanctuary and speak to the Priest in charge.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
请回到普隆德拉圣堂，与负责的牧师对话。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Now, what is your name?
{0}? Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
那么，你叫什么名字？
{0}？让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Hmm...
It seems your name
is not on my list...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
嗯...
看来你的名字
不在我的名单上...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Perhaps you should return to the Prontera Sanctuary and check the destination for your penance trial once again.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
也许你应该回到普隆德拉圣堂，再次确认你忏悔试炼的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
How is your practice coming along? I certainly hope you're enjoying living in the grace of God.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
你的修行进展如何？我真心希望你在上帝的恩典中生活得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
What?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
什么？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey.
Whatever you are,
you look like an
Acolyte applicant.

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey.
You look like an Acolyte Applicant. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
嘿。
你看起来像个服事申请者。我说得对吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
You...
Novice.
There something
you wanna tell me?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你...
初心者。
有什么事

scripts.text: [Father Yosuke]
scripts.translation: [阳介神父]

scripts.text:

Hey...
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
嘿...

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Do you have anything to say? Because unfortunately for you,
I don't any replies.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你有什么话要说吗？可惜对你来说，
我没有任何回应。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Have you any more business with me?! You don't! Go back to the Sanctuary now!
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你还有事找我吗？！没有！现在回圣堂去！

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Not bad, not bad. You withstood the penance trial pretty well.
So what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
不错，不错。你很好地经受住了忏悔试炼。
那么，你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
{0}, huh?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
{0}，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Okay. I'll send a message to the Sanctuary that you, {0}, came to visit me.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
好的。我会发消息给圣堂，确认你，{0}，来拜访过我。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Now go back to the Santuary and finish becoming an Acolyte, kid.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
现在回圣堂去，完成成为服事的仪式，小孩。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Not bad at all, you've made it all the way here from Prontera. So what's your name, kid?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
真不错，你从普隆德拉一路走到了这里。那么，你叫什么名字，小孩？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
{0}, huh? Why isn't your name on my list?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
{0}，是吗？为什么你的名字不在我的名单上？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
You probably made a mistake. Go back to the Santuary, and check with the Bishop.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你大概搞错了。回圣堂去，找主教确认一下。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
If you like, come sit here with me and meditate the great truths. God's majesty is truly inspiring...
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
如果你愿意，可以坐在这里和我一起冥想伟大的真理。上帝的威严真是令人敬畏...
